arguments.command:
command -- python3 -c 'import jsonl_changed as m
# Basic parse, unicode, CRLF, final line without newline
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"a": 1}\n{"b": 2}'"'"') == [{'"'"'a'"'"': 1}, {'"'"'b'"'"': 2}]
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"a": 1}\r\n\n  \n{"b": 2}'"'"') == [{'"'"'a'"'"': 1}, {'"'"'b'"'"': 2}]
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"k": "café"}'"'"') == [{'"'"'k'"'"': '"'"'café'"'"'}]
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"''"'"') == []
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'   \n\t\n'"'"') == []
# Malformed nonblank line
for bad in ['"'"'not json'"'"', '"'"'{"a": }'"'"', '"'"'[1,'"'"']:
    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(bad)
        raise AssertionError('"'"'expected ValueError'"'"')
    except ValueError:
        pass
# Duplicate keys at top level
for dup in ['"'"'{"a": 1, "a": 2}'"'"', '"'"'{"a": 1, "b": {"a": 2, "a": 3}}'"'"']:
    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(dup)
        raise AssertionError('"'"'expected ValueError for duplicate'"'"')
    except ValueError:
        pass
# Nested duplicate keys
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"a": {"b": 1, "c": 2}}'"'"') == [{'"'"'a'"'"': {'"'"'b'"'"': 1, '"'"'c'"'"': 2}}]
print('"'"'all checks passed'"'"')
'
